references.text: About rejoicing before the Lord's presence and enjoying the good God has given, the same theme of serving God with joy.
Describes joy before the Lord's presence as a mark of proper worship of God.
Commands to rejoice before the Lord your God during the festivals, linked to service with joy.
Commands joy during the Feast of Tabernacles, part of serving God with a glad heart.
Describes singing and joy of heart when coming to the Lord's mountain, parallel to serving God with joy.
The joy in the Lord is your strength - connects joy with worship and blessing.
Encouragement to serve the Lord with joy and come before his presence with shouting for joy.
The first Christians stayed together and broke bread with gladness and sincerity of heart, an example of serving God with joy.
Paul exhorts to rejoice in the Lord always, linked to service with joy in the heart.
